public_rationale: The records establish commercialization and reduced technical openness. They also document nonprofit safeguards and distinguish formal governance from contested practical control. Those facts support parts of Marcus's criticism, but do not settle his broader assertion about the organization as a whole by any reasonable metric. An overall supported, contradicted, or mixed verdict would require stronger evidence about actual mission adherence at the post date.
limitations: Legal structure is an incomplete measure of organizational conduct.
Most primary documents establish earlier changes rather than directly measuring the publication-date state.
Later restructuring cannot be used to establish what was already true in March 2024.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI as a whole no longer operates according to its original mission.

statement.excerpt: By any reasonable metric, OpenAI as a whole no longer works according to the mission that was originally set out.

from_speaker: the mission that was originally set out
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is a substantial organizational departure from the founding mission, not merely a change in legal structure or the existence of a paid product.
The founding commitments supply separate tests: public benefit, nonprofit oversight, freedom from shareholder-return obligations, and sharing research.
For the ongoing state, use the latest observable snapshot immediately before and at publication, February 29–March 1, 2024. Earlier founding and restructuring documents are comparison context.
Neither legal nonprofit status alone nor commercialization alone settles how the organization as a whole operates.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence about operations at publication establishes substantial abandonment across the material founding commitments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence about operations at publication establishes substantial continued adherence to the founding mission. Documented departures and meaningful continuity on distinct measures may warrant mixed.
